title: label set
description: A label set (RFC-023, RFC-032 step 6): data/labels/<dataset_id>/<set>/labels.json beside a text per item. The answers someone (a person, a model, a rule) gave for a dataset's items; never edited once written. Its id is `<dataset_id>/<set>`. A score against it is read under the label `labels-<dataset_id>-<set>`.

dataset_id.description: The dataset it labels; equals the folder above the set's.

source.description: Who or what gave the labels: a person (`by`), a model (the system and run), or a rule over a capture.

guideline.description: The guideline the labellers followed: its path and sha256.

items.description: {item_id: the label text's sha256 and the item's}: a label follows its item by the item's sha256.

actor.description: Who ran the command that wrote it (RFC-027).
